summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PulseAI. 16/16 pytest backend cases pass; all requested frontend flows work end-to-end (TL;DR hero with 5 bullets, day-grouped feed of 130 stories, category filter chip updates URL ?tag=, '/' focuses search, story detail shows headline + source-list with outbound links, bookmark + /saved works, theme toggle switches dark<->light, newsletter subscribe succeeds, /admin login with correct password loads sources dashboard with stats, toggles, and controls).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cache dict `_cache` grows unbounded (one entry per unique tag/q combination) — consider LRU cap.
Feed cache is not invalidated on admin ingestion run; new stories only appear after 60s TTL.
/api/admin/verify accepts password in body without rate limiting — brute-force risk in production.
SITE_URL is hardcoded in server.py; move to env var for portability.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded 130 stories. Newsletter subscriber TEST_pulse@example.com and TEST_ui@example.com created (idempotent). Admin source CRUD test creates+deletes TEST_Source.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass in ~1.4s. Do not repeatedly trigger POST /api/admin/run (LLM cost). Feed endpoint is cached 60s so re-testing filters uses key `feed:{tag}:{q}`.
